gloss: good and evil; right and wrong

definitions.gloss: good and evil; right and wrong
definitions.explanation: The moral distinction between what is good and what is bad.

examples.japanese: {善悪|ぜんあく}の{判断|はんだん}ができる。
examples.english: To be able to judge right from wrong.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{善悪|ぜんあく}を{教|おし}える。
examples.english: To teach children right from wrong.

examples.japanese: {善悪|ぜんあく}の{区別|くべつ}がつかない。
examples.english: To be unable to distinguish between good and evil.

notes:
{善悪|ぜんあく} is a compound noun combining {善|ぜん} (good, virtue) and {悪|あく} (evil, vice). It refers to the moral distinction between right and wrong as an abstract concept.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {善悪|ぜんあく}の{判断|はんだん}: moral judgment
- {善悪|ぜんあく}の{区別|くべつ}: distinction between right and wrong
- {善悪|ぜんあく}を{問|と}わず: regardless of good or bad
- {善悪|ぜんあく}を{見極|みきわ}める: to discern right from wrong

WORD FORMATION:
This follows a common pattern of pairing opposite kanji to form an abstract noun:
- {善悪|ぜんあく} (good and evil)
- {正邪|せいじゃ} (right and wrong)
- {是非|ぜひ} (right and wrong; by all means)
- {長短|ちょうたん} (pros and cons, long and short)

USAGE:
Primarily used in formal or philosophical discussions about morality. In everyday speech, {良|よ}い・{悪|わる}い (good/bad) is more natural.
